    Class
    Description
    SceneObjectList
    A special kind of SceneObject which is almost all the time just a collection of other SceneObjects but with the extra role of having to: Be apart of the LayerTree Be hidden and deleted via the History using Actions Be serialized by ProjectFile and reconstructed off the EDT thread via SceneObjectList.invokeSwingHooks()
